question: In September 2022, who among the following was appointed as Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lt General Anil Chauhan (Retired).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **September 2022**, Lt General **Anil Chauhan** (Retired) was appointed as **Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) **of India.
 
• Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) is a **four-star officer rank **in the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• The CDS is the **principal military advisor** to the Government of India, and is responsible for **coordinating and integrating** the operations of the three services -** Army, Navy, and Air Force.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **General Manoj Mukund Naravane** is the **current Chief of Army Staff** of the Indian Army, and assumed office on 31 December 2019.
 
• **General Dalbir Singh Suhag** is a retired **General of the Indian Army, **who served as the Chief of Army Staff from 2014 to 2016.
 
• The main and **land-based branch** of the Indian Armed Forces is the Indian Army.
 
 
• The** Chief of Army Staff **(COAS) is the professional head of the Indian Army, which is headed by the **President of India.**
